question: What kind of currency did the customer paid at 16:25:00 in 2012/8/24?

details.reason: Complete results match Gold SQL; BIRD Soft F1 = 1.0
details.actual_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.date = DATE '2012-08-24'
  AND t.time = TIME '16:25:00';
details.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.currency FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.gas_station_id = T2.gas_station_id INNER JOIN customers AS T3 ON T1.customer_id = T3.customer_id WHERE T1.date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.time = '16:25:00'
